text_block_list.text:
Seeing Sakura Chiyono O feeling unwell, I 
decided to let her rest in the 
infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I'm so pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll rest up well and get my energy back 
in no time...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —Huh? Is this... my parents' house?

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Eldest Brother
text_block_list.text:
You're finally up. Come on, the curry's 
ready, so come grab some.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Curry...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yay, we did it!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Second Older Brother
text_block_list.text:
"There's spicy and mild, but... ...You 
want spicy, right, Chiyo?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I said mild! You know that already!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Eldest Brother
text_block_list.text: No fighting. Chiyo, set out the salads.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Okaaay.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Ehh, I don't want salad.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No can do, you have to eat properly once 
in a while!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Eldest Brother
text_block_list.text: —Yes. Well then, let's eat.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~! It's so sweet, thick, and 
delicious~. Our house's curry really is 
the best!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Eldest Brother
text_block_list.text:
There's still plenty of seconds, so eat 
up.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Thank you, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ――Ah! I-I fell asleep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Still, somehow... Did I just have a really 
heartwarming dream?

Perhaps having thoroughly recovered from 
her fatigue, Sakura Chiyono O was back in 
good shape.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh!? I-It's spicy!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Second Older Brother
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Ah, my bad, wrong one!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Water, water~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —Waaateeer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wait... It was just a dream~ Man, that 
scared me...

With her rhythm thrown off, Sakura Chiyono 
O didn't seem to get enough proper rest.
